source: GDELT GKG 2.0 via BigQuery public table gdelt-bq.gdeltv2.gkg_partitioned
notes: Filter: V2Themes contains any of TAX_DISEASE_BIRD_FLU, TAX_DISEASE_AVIAN_FLU, TAX_DISEASE_AVIAN_INFLUENZA, TAX_DISEASE_POULTRY_DISEASES (there is no H5N1 theme) AND V2Locations has a US location. Day key = DATE (processing batch), not _PARTITIONTIME (ingestion).
